abstract: OBJECTIVES: The expression of Notch 1 and its ligand Jagged 2, critical factors in cell type specification, in testicular germ cell tumors was examined in order to evaluate its possible relationship with their pathogenesis. METHODS: Northern blot analysis and immunohistochemical staining for Notch 1 and Jagged 2 were done in 139 samples of testicular germ cell tumors. RESULTS: Notch 1 and Jagged 2 transcripts were expressed in noncancerous testicular tissues and Notch 1 and Jagged 2 proteins were positive in the spermatids. However, the expressions of transcript and protein were negative for both Jagged 2 and Notch 1 in seminomas, they were negative for Jagged 2 but were positive for Notch 1 in embryonal carcinomas and choriocarcinomas, and they were positive for Jagged 2 and Notch 1 in teratomas. CONCLUSIONS: Our results offer, for the first time, the possibility that the activity of the Notch signaling system, one of the cell proliferation and differentiation pathways, correlates with the different histological subtypes of germ cell tumor, which may be responsible for characteristics of cancer cells such as responses to chemotherapy and/or irradiation.
abstract_ja: 目的：精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発症との関連を評価するため、細胞型の特定に重要な因子であるNotch 1とそのリガンドであるJagged 2の、精巣胚細胞腫瘍における発現を検討した。方法：精巣胚細胞腫瘍139検体について、Notch 1およびJagged 2に対するノーザンブロット解析と免疫組織化学染色を行った。結果：Notch 1およびJagged 2の転写産物は非癌性の精巣組織で発現しており、精子細胞ではNotch 1およびJagged 2タンパク質が陽性であった。セミノーマではJagged 2およびNotch 1の転写産物とタンパク質の発現がいずれも陰性であった。胎児性癌および絨毛癌ではJagged 2は陰性だがNotch 1は陽性であった。奇形腫ではJagged 2およびNotch 1がともに陽性であった。結論：細胞の増殖と分化に関わる経路であるNotchシグナル系の活性が、胚細胞腫瘍の組織学的亜型と相関する可能性が、初めて示された。これは化学療法や放射線療法への反応など、がん細胞の特性に関与している可能性がある。
